Campaign Finance Reports (CFR)

Under Title 15 of the Texas Election Code candidates, officeholders and specific-purpose committees are required to file their campaign finance reports with the City Secretary's Office.

By law, the City Secretary does not supervise, direct or otherwise advise candidates regarding the forms required or content included in any form filed with the Office of the City Secretary.

As a service to the public, the various forms that have been filed with the City Secretary are posted below.
